historical_commentary.text: The specific Open Database template dialog mechanism described here is tied to classic Design Mode; current 4D (with Project Mode, introduced in v17) offers different, more flexible ways to scaffold new projects (including project templates and version-control-friendly text-based structures), making this note's specific UI obsolete though the underlying goal of reusable starting-point structures remains a relevant workflow need.
related_updates: 4D's later Project Mode (introduced in v17, 2018) offers a different, text-based, version-control-friendly way to scaffold and reuse project structures than the binary Design Mode template dialog described here
